title: [E-Documents Core] [Peppol] - Add PEPPOL Requested Delivery Period support (header + line)
summary: Added support for PEPPOL Requested Delivery Period at both header and line level in purchase order export, and fixed import to properly copy line-level requested delivery dates instead of silently dropping them.
key_points: New interfaces expose purchase header and line requested receipt dates for PEPPOL export
Export writes requested delivery period as XML elements at header and line level only when dates are set
Import now correctly validates and copies requested delivery date from staged sales line data
Fixed issue where line-level delivery dates from PEPPOL orders were being silently dropped
Changes covered by new test validating header and line dates are preserved independently
